# StreamDek Mobile — 14 August 2026

## New

**Premium services now work directly from your phone**
Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox, Debrid-Link and Deepbrid can now resolve
sources and check what is cached on the device instead of sending those requests through
StreamDek's servers. Each service sees your own connection rather than one shared server,
and a provider limiting another account can no longer slow down yours. Credentials kept on
the phone are encrypted with a key held by Android Keystore.

**Choose where your premium-service keys are kept**
Settings → Connections → Premium Services now lets you keep keys encrypted in your
StreamDek account, so they follow you to another phone or StreamDek TV, or keep them on
this device only. Turning cloud storage off first makes a local copy and only then removes
the account copy, so a setting change cannot accidentally lose a working credential.

**Sign in to Real-Debrid and Premiumize**
Both services now use a short pairing code that you approve on their secure website, so neither
requires finding and pasting an access key. Real-Debrid credentials are renewed automatically,
and the sign-in instructions remain on screen while you approve either service.

**See what the player is actually using**
The player dock has a new Stream Info panel. It separates what the source advertised —
provider, delivery method, quality, size and filename — from what the playback engine is
currently reporting, including resolution, codecs, transfer rate, buffer and decoder.

## Improved

**Premium-service messages stay long enough to read**
Connection results, errors, refreshes, enable or disable changes, key-storage changes and
priority updates now appear on the Premium Services page rather than disappearing in a
brief pop-up. Every notice can be dismissed immediately or will clear itself after 30
seconds. Device sign-in results follow the same rule.

**Continue Watching fills in much faster after launch**
Continue Watching used to wait for Trending, service status, watchlist and recommendations
one after another. Those independent requests now start together, so the Home row no longer
sits on its single locally remembered card while every other dashboard request finishes in
sequence.

## Fixed

**The Home spotlight can no longer stop between two titles**
Scrolling far down Home could remove the spotlight while its automatic page turn was still
moving. Returning to the top then restored that unfinished position, leaving half of one
backdrop beside half of the next. Automatic turns now pause away from the top and any
interrupted turn snaps to one complete title before the spotlight is shown again.

**Premium-service sign-in and source failures explain what happened**
Failed or cancelled sign-ins now remain visible on the Premium Services page. Sources that
cannot be resolved because a title has no IMDb identifier say so directly, and packed
Usenet posts are refused before the player is handed an archive fragment it cannot play.
